meta.question: Direct SSB was scored at the ~2 nm mother-displaced radical position (rad_buf), not the true energy-deposit site. Does scoring at the true site (a new rad_dep buffer, px) change the direct-SSB count and the indirect/direct ratio?
meta.method: Fresh v0.7.0 GPU dump with a new rad_dep buffer carrying the true deposit site (px,py,pz) written 1:1 with rad_buf; the accumulated-volume energy-threshold scorer now reads position from rad_dep, keeping rad_buf's displaced positions for the IRT chemistry. Node IRT + SSB, N=4096 / 10 keV.

same_dump_ab.note: Deterministic expectation (sum of p_break, no RNG) scoring the SAME fresh dump both ways, isolating the fix.
same_dump_ab.cross_check: old-way 27.18 reproduces the committed E32 value (27), validating the measurement; the production ssb_dir=35 is the seeded-RNG realization of the new-way ~31.5 expectation.

finding: Scoring direct SSB at the true energy-deposit site raises the in-reach ionisation count 93 -> 112 and direct SSB from ~27 to 35 (same dump), because ionisations that deposited energy within reach of a sugar were previously scored at their radical's ~2 nm-displaced thermalisation point and missed (while radicals that drifted near an unrelated sugar were spuriously credited). The indirect/direct ratio falls 7.1 -> 5.74, TOWARD but still ABOVE PARTRAC's 2-3 band. This is consistent with E31/E32: the energy threshold remains the dominant gap to the band; the ~2 nm localization error accounted for part of the excess, not all of it.

deposit_site_bracket.note: All three parameter-free points recomputed at the TRUE deposit site (deterministic p_break expectation), ind=201.
deposit_site_bracket.comment: Same qualitative bracket as the displaced-position E30/E31/E32: threshold-free in-band, energy-threshold above. The production ssb_dir=35 is the seeded-RNG realization of the ~31.5 accumulated expectation (0.6 sigma high).

supersedes: E32 (accumulated-volume at the displaced radical position, ratio 7.11). Same accumulated-volume energy-threshold model; only the scoring POSITION is corrected.
status: pass - direct-SSB localization corrected (physical-stage energy-deposit hits, as in Geant4/molecularDNA), ratio moved but still above band; threshold/volume remain the levers
